subject: darce-cli
title: No permission or approval layer of any kind: Bash executes arbitrary model-chosen commands with a full copy of process.env, silently
one_why: grep for permission/approv/confirm/sandbox/deny/allow returns zero hits across src/, test.ts, and README; the only gates are correctness checks (Zod schema, read-before-edit). Honest by omission (no phantom controls), so the subject is not deceptive -- but the model can rm -rf with the user's full environment and there is no interception point.

subject: darce-cli
title: File tools resolve model paths without containment; absolute and .. paths read/write anywhere, and WebFetch accepts model-supplied headers to arbitrary URLs
one_why: ReadTool.ts:25, WriteTool.ts:23, EditTool.ts:27 all do resolve(context.cwd, user_path) with no prefix check; WebFetchTool.ts:25-31 fetches any URL with caller-merged headers (SSRF-adjacent) and API key is stored plaintext in ~/.darcerc (cli.tsx:119).

subject: darce-cli
title: Compaction is middle-drop with a count-only placeholder summary, triggered on chars/4 estimate against a hardcoded 100k that ignores the shipped per-model contextWindow table
one_why: conversation.ts:4 hardcodes 100000 while config/models.ts:7-49 already stores contextWindow up to 1,000,000; compactMessages (:11-31) deletes the middle and inserts 'Context compacted: N messages removed' -- no summarizer, no verbatim pinning, so everything said mid-task is unrecoverable. Second harsher path: /compact slices to last 4 (REPL.tsx:80-84).

subject: darce-cli
title: retriedToolIds set is populated on every tool error but gates nothing: no retry is performed, no breaker trips
one_why: query.ts:138-144 adds tool ids on error and logs 'marking for retry', but the code never retries and never stops on repeat; the sole runaway bound is maxTurns=50 (:43), i.e., 50 identical failures burn real money before stopping.

subject: darce-cli
title: Tool calls are bucketed into concurrent vs sequential by isReadOnly/isConcurrencySafe, then the buckets are flattened and every tool runs sequentially
one_why: query.ts:130-131 does allBlocks=[...concurrent,...sequential] then a plain for-await: the safe-batch machinery is complete but unwired, so parallel read-only fan-out (the cheap win) never happens; a textbook half-implemented feature that also misleads readers of the code.

subject: darce-cli
title: EditTool refuses edits to files not previously Read, enforced via a readFiles Set on ToolContext, and it is tested
one_why: Cheapest possible hallucinated-edit guard: membership check, ~3 lines, with a passing test (test.ts:329-334); nuance vs mini-kode's hash variant: darce's set resets to empty on --resume (cli.tsx:241), so resumed sessions must re-read before editing (arguably safer, surprising otherwise).

subject: darce-cli
title: 106 behavioral tests with a hand-rolled runner, zero CI: no .github/ exists, and the loop, compaction, and REPL are untested while WebFetch tests hit live httpbin.org
one_why: test.ts genuinely asserts behavior (SSE edge cases :543-591, EditTool semantics :325-386, router precedence :698-731) but nothing ever runs it automatically, and network-dependent tests (:508-511) mean it cannot pass offline -- the suite rots by construction.

subject: darce-cli
title: README advertises 'Smart routing -- auto-picks the best model for each task' but the shipped default router config has rules: [], making routing inert out of the box
one_why: router.ts:36-50 is real (conversation-shape conditions: tool-rounds>=3, tokens>100k, image presence) but only fires on user-authored rules; default is always qwen/qwen3-coder. Related drift: --version prints hardcoded '0.2.2' (cli.tsx:5) while package.json:3 says 0.3.5.

subject: darce-cli
title: MIT declared in package.json but no LICENSE file in tree and GitHub reports license:null
one_why: Third corpus instance (after coro-code, g3, zap-coding-agent); absent LICENSE means the declared MIT has no operative text, so any reuse of darce-cli ideas must stay concepts-only with clean-room effort.
